bio.text: Adam Ortiz is an independent candidate for Vermont's at-large U.S. House seat in the November 3, 2026 general election, and took part in Vermont Public's October 2026 debate with Rep. Becca Balint and Republican Gerald Malloy.
According to Ballotpedia, he was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 2006 to 2012.
